map.由视差求物体深度: Find the object depth from the disparity
map.输入焦距 f（像素）、基线 B、视差 d（像素），求深度。: Enter the focal length f in pixels, the baseline B and the disparity d in pixels to get the depth.
map.📖 查看「由视差求物体深度 使用指南」: 📖 View Guide: "Find the object depth from the disparity"
map.Z = fB/d（小孔模型）。: Z = fB/d under the pinhole model.
map.视差求物体深度。: Get the object depth from the disparity.
map.焦距 500px、基线 0.1m、视差 25px: Focal length 500 px, baseline 0.1 m, disparity 25 px
map.d=12.5 → Z=4m，视差越小越远（深度与视差成反比）。: d = 12.5 gives Z = 4 m; a smaller disparity means a greater distance, since depth is inversely proportional to disparity.
map.f、d 同取像素，B 取米，则 Z 为米。: Take f and d in pixels and B in metres, and Z comes out in metres.
map.近处误差大？: Is the error larger up close?
map.是；深度对视差变化敏感，近处更不稳。: Yes. Depth is sensitive to changes in disparity, so it is less stable nearby.
